info.title: Wandance (ITA)
info.synopsis: Kaboku Kotani sta per iniziare il liceo e ha intenzione di continuare con la sua solita vita: andare d'accordo con i suoi amici, starsene in silenzio e non attirare troppo l'attenzione su di sé. In fin dei conti è già abbastanza difficile cavarsela con una balbuzie come la sua, perché dovrebbe peggiorare le cose distinguendosi dalla massa? Ma poi vede un'altra matricola, Hikari Wanda, che balla come se nessuno la stesse guardando... o per essere precisi, a lei non sembra importare del giudizio delle persone. Kaboku, colpito dall'atteggiamento della ragazza, inizia a chiedersi come potrebbe raggiungere la stessa libertà. Per trovare risposta a questo suo dubbio fa una cosa impensabile per lui: iscriversi al club di ballo. Dopotutto ogni cambiamento inizia con un piccolo passo, giusto? Unisciti a Kaboku e Wanda mentre si fanno strada verso la vita e l'amore!

episodes.title: Il Ballo di Wanda
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, a high school freshman struggling with a stutter, meets Wanda, who dances alone without concern for others. Feeling stifled by what other people think of him, Kabo is captivated by Wanda's free-spirited moves. He begins to take an interest in dance as a form of self-expression.

episodes.title: Rapporto tra Generi del Club di Ballo
episodes.synopsis: During a trial session with the dance club, Kabo learns the basic moves and the importance of truly listening to the music from the club president, On. Though awkward at first, Kabo gradually settles into the club and begins practicing one-on-one with Wanda after school.

episodes.title: Audizione
episodes.synopsis: To prepare for a high school dance contest in June, the dance club holds a freestyle audition. Drawn in by Wanda's dancing, Kabo begins to grasp how to let his body be moved by the music. On the way home, he learns about On's hopes for this year's contest.

episodes.title: Coreografia
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, Wanda, and Aoi are chosen to take part in the contest. Meanwhile, Yura, who was not selected, struggles to accept the decision. Kabo happens to run into another male club member Iori, who performed in last year's contest.

episodes.title: Gara
episodes.synopsis: At last, the day of the dance contest arrives for Ichirin High School. With all the unique rival schools gathered, the tension at the venue peaks. Encouraged by Iori and Wanda, Kabo steps onto the stage. Everything hangs on whether the dancers can bring passion to their performance.

episodes.title: La Vita di Wanda Prima delle Superiori
episodes.synopsis: The results of the high school dance contest are out. Though they are dancing together, Kabo feels distance from Wanda, and recalls how she used to dance alone when they first met. Before entering high school, Wanda worked part-time at a convenience store while practicing dance entirely on her own.

episodes.title: Sfida di Ballo
episodes.synopsis: Right after the contest, On and Iori face off in a dance battle. Kabo and Wanda are both in awe of how the pair challenges each other's technique and style as they reach new heights. After the club members judge, Iori selects Kabo as On's next battle opponent.

episodes.title: Il Muro dello Stile
episodes.synopsis: Kabo starts training with Iori during lunch and begins to discover the thrill of dance battles. Iori mentions a skilled dancer called Gaku Kabeya, or Kabe, who specializes in breakdancing. Iori invites Kabo and Wanda to join the B-BOY's practice at the park, where Kabe is also training.

episodes.title: Eliminatorie
episodes.synopsis: The solo division of the Inter-High Dance Battle begins, and On, Iori, and Wanda advance smoothly through the prelims. Shaken by Wanda's absence and the unfamiliar environment, Kabo messes up his timing. Confused, he finishes the prelims without showing his true strengths.

episodes.title: Consapevolezza di Sé
episodes.synopsis: In the second match of round one in the Inter-High Dance Battle, On faces Usen Takumi, a dancer with a unique style. Kabo is moved by the fierce performances of On and Wanda, unlike anything he has seen in practice. But Kabe thinks battles are meaningless unless you win.

episodes.title: Wandance
episodes.synopsis: Kabo faces Kabe in the semifinals. Taking the first turn, Kabe blindfolds himself with a mask, and finishes the first song as if to say Kabo's dance is not even worth watching. Confronting Kabe's raw emotion head-on, Kabo's own feelings begin to break free.

info.plot: Kaboku Kotani sta per iniziare il liceo e ha intenzione di continuare con la sua solita vita: andare d'accordo con i suoi amici, starsene in silenzio e non attirare troppo l'attenzione su di sé. In fin dei conti è già abbastanza difficile cavarsela con una balbuzie come la sua, perché dovrebbe peggiorare le cose distinguendosi dalla massa? Ma poi vede un'altra matricola, Hikari Wanda, che balla come se nessuno la stesse guardando... o per essere precisi, a lei non sembra importare del giudizio delle persone. Kaboku, colpito dall'atteggiamento della ragazza, inizia a chiedersi come potrebbe raggiungere la stessa libertà. Per trovare risposta a questo suo dubbio fa una cosa impensabile per lui: iscriversi al club di ballo. Dopotutto ogni cambiamento inizia con un piccolo passo, giusto? Unisciti a Kaboku e Wanda mentre si fanno strada verso la vita e l'amore!
